 Lakers vs. Clippers Picks, Predictions, Props & Odds for Late Night NBA Action
 Michael Sciangula Oct 28, 2026 3:00 PM EDT 5 min read 
 Home / Lakers Vs Clippers Picks Predictions Props Odds For Late Night NBA Action 
 The Lakers and Clippers meet for the second time in six days on Wednesday night, this time at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood. Tipoff is scheduled for 10:30 p.m. ET.
 The Lakers took the first meeting 125-117 last Friday, led by Austin Reaves , who finished with 28 points and nine assists.
 They are, however, coming off their first loss of the season after falling 136-129 at home to Portland on Tuesday night despite 41 points and nine assists from Luka Doncic . They’ll now face the Clippers on the second night of a back-to-back.
 The Clippers last played on Sunday, falling 108-101 on the road against Oklahoma City. Darius Garland recorded a double-double with 16 points and 11 assists, but the Clippers committed 26 turnovers in the loss, including six from Garland.
 Lakers vs. Clippers Odds Today 
 The Lakers are listed as 4.5-point road favorites for Wednesday night’s matchup at Hard Rock Bet Sportsbook :
 Moneyline : Lakers (-190), Clippers (+155)
 Spread : Lakers -4.5 (-110), Clippers +4.5 (-110)
 Total : Over 228.5 (-110), Under 228.5 (-110)
 Best Player Prop Bets for Lakers vs. Clippers 
 With both teams looking to bounce back from losses last time out, Wednesday’s matchup offers a wide range of basketball betting markets at Hard Rock Bet Sportsbook. Using insights and trends from the Stats Hub , we’ve identified two player props worth considering for tonight’s game.
 Austin Reaves Over 26.5 Points + Rebounds (-115) 
 Reaves has cleared this line in five consecutive games dating back to last season, including all four games to open the 2026-27 campaign.
 The Lakers guard has been one of the team’s most reliable contributors, averaging more than 26 points per game while shooting 63.3% from the field. He’s also getting to the free throw line regularly, currently averaging a career-high nine trips to the charity strip per game.
 Reaves scored 28 points against the Clippers last Friday and followed up that performance with 29 against Utah and 26 against Portland. He’s come close to clearing tonight’s points + rebounds total with his scoring alone in each of those games.
 Austin Reaves Over 26.5 Points + Rebounds (-115) 
 Darius Garland Under 36.5 Points + Assists + Rebounds (-115) 
 Garland has finished under this PRA total in five consecutive games dating back to last season, including all three of his appearances with the Clippers this season.
 Tonight’s line of 36.5 is a relatively high number for Garland, who enters Wednesday averaging 24 points and seven assists through three games. Even with an increased workload, he’s yet to reach 37 combined points, assists and rebounds in any game this season.
 The Lakers also kept Garland below this number in Friday’s win, despite the Clippers guard playing nearly 37 minutes and attempting 19 shots. He finished with 26 points and six assists while committing nine turnovers.
 In last night’s loss to Portland, the Lakers allowed 23 points and four assists to Ja Morant, while Damian Lillard finished with 21 points, five rebounds and four assists. Neither reached 30 PRA.
 Darius Garland Under 36.5 Points + Assists + Rebounds (-115)
